subtitle: The Living Cinema — Discovery Library, Sovereign Theater and Poster Forge
changes: Added gorgeous streaming-style discovery shelves from actual private local videos: Continue Watching, Favorites, Recent and named collections.
Added title-searchable cinematic movie cards and real detail pages with local favorite toggles, collection renaming and instant play/resume.
Added Sovereign Theater playback controls for the existing Video Vault player: pause, seek, skip, fullscreen, PiP and focus without duplicate decoding.
Added Poster Forge for still image imports, safe saved-video frame capture, zoom/focus adjustments and optional local title overlay.
Poster edits write only the existing saved-video poster field, retaining original movie file bytes, imported personal GIF covers and playback metadata.
Connected the cinematic homepage to the new library, polished responsive iPhone/PC artwork and retained all 18 studios, PWA rollback and Home Screen custom icon settings.
